description: This file defines classes for the UI components related to the Delegated Granular Administration section in the Mattermost system console, including role management panels and data grid interactions.

classes.name: DelegatedGranularAdministration
classes.description: Main class representing the Delegated Granular Administration section, providing access to the admin roles panel and system roles page.

classes.name: AdminRolesPanel
classes.description: Represents the Admin Roles panel within the section, providing visibility checks and role row accessors.

classes.name: DataGrid
classes.description: Handles the data grid containing role rows, providing visibility check and role row accessors.

classes.name: RoleRow
classes.description: Represents a single role row in the data grid, with methods to interact and retrieve role information.

methods.name: DelegatedGranularAdministration.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the main section with container locator, header, admin roles panel, and system roles page.

methods.name: DelegatedGranularAdministration.toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks that the section container and header are visible.

methods.name: AdminRolesPanel.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the admin roles panel with container locator, title, description, and data grid.

methods.name: AdminRolesPanel.toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks that the panel container and title are visible.

methods.name: DataGrid.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the data grid with container locator and role rows.

methods.name: DataGrid.toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks that the data grid container is visible.

methods.name: RoleRow.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a role row with container locator and edit test ID.

methods.name: RoleRow.toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks that the role row container is visible.

methods.name: RoleRow.clickEdit
methods.description: Clicks the edit link for the role.
